The existing DP is an exact directed Steiner-tree solver, which is the strongest available cost optimization because it charges a shared relay edge only once. The current cutoff unnecessarily falls back to independent shortest paths for broadcasts containing 11–13 destinations, losing opportunities to share expensive inter-cloud links.

Raising the cutoff to 13 keeps the exponential work bounded (`3^13` subset-combination scale) while allowing medium fan-out configurations to receive the exact shared-tree optimization. This is especially valuable when several destinations can be reached through the same low-cost relay cloud.
